title: Havells Valerio+ 25L Convertible Storage Water Heater (Geyser) | Dual Heating Element | 3-in-1 Convertible Modes | Feroglas Coated Tank | Whirlflow Technology | White & Blue
description: Experience powerful performance and efficient hot water with the Havells Valerio+ 25L Convertible Storage Water Heater. With advanced 3-in-1 Convertible Heating Modes (1kW, 2kW, 3kW), you get 33% faster heating while choosing energy-saving options when required. The Feroglas Coated Tank and Incoloy Glass-Coated Heating Element deliver durability and resistance against corrosion, even in hard water. Equipped with Whirlflow Technology, it ensures up to 20% more hot water output by preventing mixing of hot and cold streams. Its high working pressure (0.8 MPa) makes it perfect for high-rise buildings, while the high-density PUF insulation keeps water hot for longer. Safety is ensured with a high-precision thermostat, thermal cut-out, safety valve, and fire-retardant power cord. With dual adjustable knobs, you can easily control temperature and wattage to suit your comfort.

specifications.Included Components: 1 N Multifunction Safety Valve, 1 N Storage Electric Water Heater, 2 N Flexible pipes, 2 N fasteners
specifications.Special Features: 3-in-1 Convertible Heating, 33% Faster Heating, Feroglas Tank Protection, High Pressure Resistant (0.8 MPa), Whirlflow Technology
